title: CCGM Audit Pack Manifest
description: Schema for a CCGM /audit check pack manifest. `applies_when` is the sole gating mechanism — conditions are project-shape flags, language predicates, or the literal `always`.

applies_when.description: Gating conditions. ALL items must be satisfied for the pack to run. Items are project-shape flags, `language:<lang>` predicates, or the literal `always`.

anyOf.description: Project-shape flags emitted by the ecosystem detector.
Language predicate — `language:<lang>` where lang is lowercase.

tags.description: Free-form labels for filtering and display.

severity_floor.description: Minimum severity a check in this pack will ever emit; used for display filtering.

tools.description: Spine tools this pack may invoke. Tools not present are skipped gracefully.

checks.description: Ordered list of checks this pack defines.

id.description: Stable check identifier, e.g. `dm/unquoted-reserved-keyword`. Must be unique within the pack.

severity.description: Consequence severity of this check finding. Declared here and enforced by the rubric emitter.

confidence.description: Precision of this check's signal. Separate from severity.

detection.description: How this check produces findings: deterministic tool, LLM agent, or hybrid (tool finds candidates, LLM confirms).

tool.description: Spine tool that runs this check. Required when detection is `tool` or `hybrid`.

rule.description: Rule identifier within the tool, e.g. a Semgrep rule ID or ESLint rule name.

fallback.description: Fallback mechanism when the primary tool is absent, e.g. `grep` or `llm`.

auto_fixable.description: Whether findings from this check can be automatically fixed.
